description: Every path, flag and list a template may use. app/lib/context.js builds this object from the profile and region data; validate.mjs rejects anything not listed. Request additions in your worker notes.

values.household.name: A display name the household chose for the binder cover, else "Our household".
values.household.children: Count of teens, children and infants.
values.home.town: Nearest town, or the county name if blank.
values.home.setting: urban | suburban | small-town | rural | remote, as words.
values.dwelling.shelter_room: The windowless interior room the household named.
values.dwelling.pool_gallons: Pool or hot tub size in gallons.
values.contacts.out_of_area.name: Out-of-area contact name.
values.contacts.utility.electric.provider: Electric provider as typed by the household.
values.gear.house_connection: How the generator connects to the house, as words.
values.gear.food.pantry_days: Days of pantry food, household estimate.
values.derived.water.floor_gal_day: Drinking + minimal hygiene floor: 1 gal per person per day, +0.5 gal per nursing or pregnant member, +0.5 gal per infant for formula and hygiene, +0.25 gal per pet (FEMA/CDC basis; formula in app/lib/derive.js).
values.derived.water.plan_gal_day: Planning figure: floor x 1.3, rounded to 0.25 gal.
values.derived.water.two_weeks_gal: plan_gal_day x 14, rounded up to 5 gal.
values.derived.calories.day: Sum of per-member daily calories from the published USDA Dietary Guidelines estimated-needs table by age and sex at the moderately active level; pregnant +340 (2nd trimester figure) and nursing +330 (first 6 months of lactation; +400 after, Dietary Guidelines 2020-2025) printed as published.
values.derived.station_fridge_days: Rough days a power station bank runs a typical full-size fridge at 1.2 kWh/day: gear.station_wh_total x 0.85 / 1200, one decimal. Printed as an estimate.
values.derived.supply_clocks: Not a value: a table built from the household meds rows (name, days on hand).
values.region.dest.state_name: State name (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.state_name).
values.region.dest.zone: USDA hardiness zone (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.zone).
values.region.dest.last_frost: Median last spring frost (date) (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.last_frost).
values.region.dest.first_frost: Median first fall frost (date) (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.first_frost).
values.region.dest.growing_days: Median frost-free days (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.growing_days).
values.region.home.jan_low_f: January mean daily low, deg F (home base).
values.region.dest.jan_low_f: January mean daily low, deg F (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.jan_low_f).
values.region.home.jul_high_f: July mean daily high, deg F (home base).
values.region.dest.jul_high_f: July mean daily high, deg F (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.jul_high_f).
values.region.dest.record_low_f: Record low, deg F (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.record_low_f).
values.region.dest.record_high_f: Record high, deg F (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.record_high_f).
values.region.dest.precip_in: Annual precipitation, inches (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.precip_in).
values.region.dest.snow_in: Annual snowfall, inches (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.snow_in).
values.region.home.elevation_ft: Approximate county seat elevation, ft (home base).
values.region.dest.elevation_ft: Approximate county seat elevation, ft (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.elevation_ft).
values.region.home.ecoregion: EPA Level III ecoregion name (home base).
values.region.dest.ecoregion: EPA Level III ecoregion name (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.ecoregion).
values.region.dest.nws_office: NWS forecast office name (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.nws_office).
values.region.home.nwr: Not a value: list of NOAA Weather Radio transmitters (call sign, frequency MHz, SAME code) (home base).
values.region.dest.nwr: Not a value: list of NOAA Weather Radio transmitters (call sign, frequency MHz, SAME code) (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.nwr).
values.region.home.state_em: State emergency management agency name (home base).
values.region.dest.state_em: State emergency management agency name (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.state_em).
values.region.home.hazards: Not a value: list of hazards with rating 1 to 3 (home base).
values.region.dest.hazards: Not a value: list of hazards with rating 1 to 3 (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.hazards).
values.region.home.plants.deadly: Not a value: list of plant keys for deadly plants and look-alikes (home base).
values.region.dest.plants.deadly: Not a value: list of plant keys for deadly plants and look-alikes (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.plants.deadly).
values.region.home.plants.edible: Not a value: list of plant keys for safe starter edibles (home base).
values.region.dest.plants.edible: Not a value: list of plant keys for safe starter edibles (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.plants.edible).
values.region.home.trees.firewood: Not a value: list of firewood tree keys (home base).
values.region.dest.trees.firewood: Not a value: list of firewood tree keys (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.trees.firewood).
values.region.home.sun_hours_dec: Mean peak sun hours in December (home base).
values.region.dest.sun_hours_dec: Mean peak sun hours in December (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.sun_hours_dec).
values.region.home.sun_hours_jun: Mean peak sun hours in June (home base).
values.region.dest.sun_hours_jun: Mean peak sun hours in June (inside #each destinations as x: x.region.sun_hours_jun).
values.gear.generator_volts: Generator output: "120 V only" or "120/240 V".
values.derived.rain_gal_per_inch: Rain caught per inch of rain: roof_area_sqft x 0.623 gallons (standard catchment conversion), before losses.
values.region.home.latitude: Latitude of the home county centroid, one decimal (home base).
values.derived.solar_wh_dec: Rough daily solar harvest in December: gear.solar_w_total x region.home.sun_hours_dec x 0.75 (system losses), rounded. Printed as an estimate.
values.dwelling.warm_room: The room the household chose to heat as its warm room (free text).
values.gear.firearms.platforms: Firearm platforms and calibers as the household typed them.

flags.has.elder: A member over 70 or role elder.
flags.has.condition.CL-NN: Any member has condition CL-NN (one flag per library id, e.g. has.condition.CL-01).
flags.has.mobility_aid: A member uses a wheelchair or walker.
flags.has.house_connection: Generator connection is interlock, cord-and-plug or transfer switch.
flags.has.power_station: Owns at least one power station.
flags.is.cold_winters: Home January mean low below 20 F.
flags.is.hot_summers: Home July mean high above 90 F.
flags.is.coastal: Home county is on an ocean or Gulf coast.
flags.has.adult_over_40: A member aged 40 or over (FDA potassium iodide guidance differs over 40).
flags.has.food_allergy: Any allergy row (any severity) for a food.
flags.has.diabetes: Any member with CL-01, CL-02, CL-05 or CL-06.
flags.is.humid: Home July mean dew point high (humid continental, humid subtropical or coastal climate per region data).

meds.description: All medication rows across members, as typed.

destinations.description: Destinations, each with its own region object.

adults.description: Members whose role is adult or elder. Same fields as members.

children.description: Members under 13 (child or infant-toddler). Same fields as members.

infants.description: Members under 24 months. Same fields as members.

teens.description: Members 13 to 17. Same fields as members.

elders.description: Members over 70 or role elder. Same fields as members.

region.home.trees.firewood.description: Firewood trees of the home ecoregion.

region.home.plants.deadly.description: Deadly plants and look-alikes of the home ecoregion.

region.home.plants.edible.description: Safe-starter edibles of the home ecoregion.

region.dest.nwr.description: Inside #each destinations as x: x.region.nwr transmitters.

region.home.nearby_same.description: SAME codes of counties adjacent to home (for programming a weather radio).

formatting.arrays: Rendered as a readable comma list ("a, b and c").
formatting.numbers: Rendered with thousands separators; derived values carry the rounding in their description.
formatting.nested: members[].conditions, allergies and skills render as readable comma lists of names (condition names from the library, not ids).
